sourceText:
Onion Board
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 12:05am

Ingredients




2 teaspoons Yeast
1 cup Warm Water
1 teaspoon Sugar
1 1/2 teaspoons Salt
1 1/2 cups AP Flour
1 1/2 cups Bread Flour
1 tablespoon Olive Oil
1 1/2 cups Chopped Onion
3 Cloves of Chopped Garlic
2 tablespoons Butter
1/8 cup Kraft Grated American Cheese Food

Preparation

1 This comes in a gold can usually next to the Parmesan Cheese. 2 Note. I have used Parmesan and grated Cheddar cheese. 3 Put the first 7 ingredients into the bread machine. select the dough making option. If not using a bread machine knead well and let raise for one hour) 4 Grill or Microwave the Onions, Garlic and butter until soft. Let cool. 5 Method One... Looks better.. Spray counter top with Pam, When the dough is ready, remove from ABM and spray with Pam, then roll out about 1/2 thick into a 14x10 rectangle. Transfer to a oiled cookie sheet. 6 Method Two.. 7 Makes a slightly thicker Crust.. Put dough into a oiled 13X9 pan. Spread out with your fingers until its all evenly spread out. 8 Spread the Onions and Garlic over the dough and press lightly into the dough. Sprinkle on the Cheese, to taste. (lots) 9 Note. The last time I sprinkled on some Powdered Garlic bread seasoning that I use. (In addition to all the other stuff) It definitely added a bit to the flavors. 10 Bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until done. Putting under the broiler for 1 minute at the end will darken up the onions real nice.
